== Title ==
<span lang="ja">トーントーン使い</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">騎乗する乗用生物の戦闘力に2を加える。トーントーンに乗っているなら、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に1枚引ける。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">コーマン・クィエンはエコー基地の偵察兵の典型と言える。野生のトーントーンを捕まえ、手なずけ、訓練を行うのだ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tauntaun Handler]].

'''Lore''' — Corman Quien is a typical scout at Echo Base. He captures, tames, and trains wild tauntauns.

'''Game text''' — Adds 2 to the power of any creature vehicle he rides. If he is on a tauntaun, he may draw one battle destiny when not otherwise able to.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese says he rides a creature vehicle; the English says he drives it. The Japanese lore is present tense; the English uses past tense for capturing and training the native tauntauns.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-tauntaunhandler-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Tauntaun Handler]].</ref>
